cut: Global 2, VIRAL CUT v2 (23 Oct) of Ends in 3. Owner on v1: 'needs clarity of messaging'. Four beats: what (the 3s die), why (not linked to an ID), how (by last digit), the alert. Hook-first, and the last frame hands back to the first (plan/films/23b-ends-in-3-viral.md).
argument: Mexico cut off 2.2 million phone lines not linked to an ID (a rule against extortion and fraud), by last digit, 5s due 31 October; cut-off phones still get the quake alert.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: Mexico: / [2.2 million] phone / lines cut off.
text.ja: メキシコ: / [220万] 回線が / 停止。

captions.source: CRT figures via El Financiero, 5 Oct 2026: 2,248,143 lines ending in 3 suspended after their deadline (30 Sep, grace to 3 Oct), as of 4 Oct; about 1.21 million reactivated by then. Search summaries, 23 Oct (plan/films/23-ends-in-3.md).

text.en: Not linked to an ID: / a new rule against / [extortion, fraud].
text.fi: Ei liitetty henkilötunnukseen: / uusi sääntö / [kiristystä, petoksia] vastaan.
text.ja: IDに 未登録。 / [恐喝と 詐欺] 対策の / 新ルール。

captions.source: Mexico's telecom regulator, the CRT: since 9 Jan 2026 every mobile line must be linked to its holder's name and CURP (national ID number) through the phone company; lines not linked by their deadline are suspended. The stated aim is to end the anonymous lines used for extortion and fraud (El Financiero, Mexico News Daily, Crónica; search summaries, 23 Oct).

text.en: Cut by last digit: / 3s, then 4s, / [5s] next, on 31 Oct.
text.ja: 末尾の 数字順に 停止: / 3、 次に 4、 / [5] は 10月31日。

captions.source: The CRT's calendar by the line's last digit (0 on 15 Aug to 9 on 31 Dec). Lines ending in 3: due 30 Sep (grace to 3 Oct), 2,248,143 suspended as of 4 Oct (El Financiero, 5 Oct). Ending in 4: due 15 Oct, suspended within 72 hours, 1,328,000 by 19 Oct (Informador). Ending in 5: due 31 Oct, not moved as of 23 Oct (Excélsior, Xataka, N+, UnoTV; search summaries, 23 Oct). The 0s to 2s went before; the calendar shows them crossed.

text.en: No calls, no texts. / But quake alerts / still [get through].
text.fi: Ei puheluita, ei viestejä. / Mutta maanjäristysvaroitus / [menee silti läpi].
text.ja: 通話も SMSも 不可。 / でも 地震警報は / [届く]。

captions.source: CRT, as carried by El Universal, Milenio, Xataka, ADN40 and El Imparcial (search summaries, 23 Oct): a suspended line cannot make or receive ordinary calls, send texts or use data, yet still receives the seismic alert and can still call 911; it is not cancelled, and service returns once the line is linked. The station's line over its own image; not a quote.

calendar.ja: CRT · 末尾の 数字ごとの 期限

digits.why: each phone shows the last digit of its line; numbers, the same in every master

calendar.why: the calendar of deadlines by last digit (CRT); digits and day/month dates, the same in every master

id.why: the card's band and the name of Mexico's national ID number; the photo is a mask, no face, no name

alert.en: a triangle with a seismograph trace
alert.why: the alert screen is an icon only, so no master says the wrong words; it shows an alert, never a quake

number.why: a phone number with its middle masked (no real number), its last digit boxed; digits only, the same in every master

post.en: Mexico cut off 2.2 million phone lines whose owners hadn't linked them to an ID, under a rule against extortion and fraud. It goes by last digit: 3s, then 4s; 5s due 31 Oct. Lines come back once linked, and cut-off phones still get the quake alert. What does your number end in?
post.es: México suspendió 2,2 millones de líneas que sus titulares no vincularon a su CURP, por una regla contra la extorsión y el fraude. Va por último dígito: 3, luego 4; el 5 vence el 31 de octubre. Vuelven al vincularse, y aún reciben la alerta sísmica. ¿En qué termina la tuya?
post.fi: Meksiko katkaisi 2,2 miljoonaa liittymää, joita ei ollut liitetty henkilötunnukseen: sääntö kiristystä ja petoksia vastaan. Loppunumeron mukaan: 3:t, sitten 4:t, 5:t 31.10. Liittymä palaa, kun se liitetään, ja maanjäristysvaroitus tulee silti perille. Mihin numerosi päättyy?
post.ja: メキシコで220万回線が停止。持ち主のIDに未登録だったため。恐喝と詐欺対策の新ルールで、末尾の数字順に停止：3、次に4、末尾5の期限は10月31日。登録すれば回線は戻り、停止中でも地震警報は届く。あなたの番号の末尾は？
